title: Venezuelan Corn Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, made with fresh corn and a hint of zesty spice.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, mix together corn kernels, cornbread mix, zesty spice mix, and shredded cheese (if using).
Gradually add in water to form a thick batter.
Using a spoon, scoop the batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
